mainEntity.name: Why does skilled-worker basis matter in a skilled residency matter?

acceptedAnswer.text: In client terms, work and business routes depend on the real activity in Brazil, the structure around it, and documents that match the proposed purpose closely. In real cases, skilled-worker basis changes route fit, documents, and timing. No public explanation can replace a review of the actual file.

mainEntity.name: Why does qualification alignment matter in a skilled residency matter?

acceptedAnswer.text: In client terms, the route has to match the client's real objective, present status, and supporting facts before any serious next step is taken. In real cases, qualification alignment changes route fit, documents, and timing. No public explanation can replace a review of the actual file.

acceptedAnswer.text: The practical point is that the competent authority matters because the same objective can involve different procedures, booking systems, and expectations depending on where the step occurs.
